26. Password Reset Flow

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Use a cryptographically random, expiring, single-use reset token and generic request responses.
සිංහJලෙන් Password reset request එකට account එක තිJයනවද කියලා Jහළි Jනාකර response Jදන්න.
Random token එJකේ hash එක තබා, expire සහ single-use checks කරන්න.
A user receives a reset link by email and chooses a new password.

VISUAL MODEL · STEP 1 / 3 PROCESS FLOW STEP 2 / 4 · Reset request Random token and stored hash · Email link Atomic consume and update · Read the diagram: Reset request → Random token and stored hash → Email link → Atomic consume and update. · Password reset request එකට account එක තිJයනවද කියලා Jහළි Jනාකර response Jදන්න. Random token එJකේ · hash එක තබා, expire සහ single-use checks කරන්න.
Expected result: Database holds digest; successful reset consumes the token atomically.

Why hash reset tokens? They are high-entropy secrets; hashing limits exposure from database
leaks.

PRACTICE
List checks before replacing a password and
revoking old sessions.
